title: Does Fast Mode Do Anything?
brief: An hourly-updated benchmark site testing whether Codex Fast mode delivers on its promise of 2× speed for 2.5× the usage — a running provider comparison of Fast mode against standard. Bare link share ("lol"); figures are the site's own measurements.
details: A single-purpose benchmark site that re-tests OpenAI Codex's Fast mode every hour, measuring throughput (tokens per second) and latency (time to first token) in paired normal-vs-fast runs to check whether Fast mode delivers its promised 2x speed for 2.5x the usage. Powered by "omp bench" (omp.sh). (Coverage note: written from the Discord embed and the site's own framing — the live page's benchmark results are JS-rendered and were not directly fetchable.)
